tenderSchedule.title: Tender for the production of 71 gold medals to be awarded to the 2026 Rajyotsava awardees
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for manufacturing 71 gold medals weighing 25 grams, 22 carats, to be awarded to the 2026 Rajyotsava awardees
tenderSchedule.locationName: Director Department of Kannada and culture

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per the following tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Submit a copy of the payment details of the tender processing fee and EMD amount.
All terms and condition following the tender documents
A letter of incorporation, sole proprietorship/partnership/joint venture/limited company/other, as per the registration of the organization, should be attached.
PAN Card and GST Number should be mentioned (Self-attested photocopies should be attached)
Attach copy of the document with the number and date of the official BIS Hallmark Seal License Certificate obtained from the competent authority.
Attach work orders and experience certificates/disposal challans received from government, semi-government, and corporation boards for the Making of gold medals in the last 05 years.
Attach a certificate certified by the auditor regarding the transaction of 06 crores in the Year of 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Submit copies of income tax returns for the years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25, certified by the auditor.
Attaching GST (Returns File) documents for the last 06 months

itemList.itemName: Total cost of manufacturing 71 gold medals weighing 25 grams each of 22 carats, including the emblem of the Karnataka State Government and Rajyotsava Award 2026 on the front of the gold medal and the name of the awardee on the back of the gold medal, including die charge, making charge, service charges (inclusive of GST and all other taxes) A set of golden colored thread and velvet box
